(Japanese: '''ポケモンコンテスト！ソノオ大会！！''' ''Pokémon Contest! {{tt|Sonoo|Floaroma}} Tournament!!'') is the 26th episode of ''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl]]'', and the 492nd episode of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. It first aired in Japan on April 5, 2007, as part of a one-hour special with [[DP027]], and in the United States on September 1, 2007. {{spoilers}} ==Blurb== With time running out before the start of the Floaroma Town Pokémon Contest, Dawn and Pachirisu are getting in as much training as they can. But it's not just Ash and Brock who are watching from the sidelines, because Dawn's friend Kenny is here to compete in the Contest, too! Both Dawn and Kenny are from Twinleaf Town, and Kenny is full of embarrassing stories about Dawn's childhood. What's more, he chose a Piplup for his first Pokémon, just like Dawn, but his Piplup is now a Prinplup with an attitude! To add injury to insult, Kenny turns down a challenge from Dawn and asks to battle Ash and Pikachu instead. Pikachu should have the type advantage, but Kenny's Prinplup counters Pikachu's attacks by using its own moves in creative ways. It's so impressive that Team Rocket makes a grab for Prinplup—in order to boost Jessie's chances of Contest victory, James and Meowth are on a mission to steal Pokémon! Prinplup is unable to escape, so Dawn sends Piplup to stop Team Rocket. Piplup uses a newly-learned move, Whirlpool, to give Prinplup back some of its pep, and the two Water-type Pokémon then beat Team Rocket with a double Bubble Beam. Today's teamwork was terrific, but both Dawn and Kenny have their eye on winning tomorrow's Contest. What will happen once these old friends become new rivals...? ==Plot== With one day before the [[Floaroma Town]] [[Pokémon Contest]], {{an|Dawn}} is {{pkmn|training}} hard. {{AP|Pikachu}} demonstrates to {{TP|Dawn|Pachirisu}} how to store electricity in order to gain more appeal. Pachirisu follows suit, releasing its stored electricity and creates a sparkle show similar to Pikachu. Pachirisu begs for Dawn's [[Poffin]], and she gives it and {{TP|Dawn|Piplup}} some. Both {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} want more Poffin, and Dawn refuses until they train some more. Pachirisu gets angry and uses {{m|Discharge}} on all of them. Pikachu stops Pachirisu with {{m|Thunderbolt}}, though Dawn's hair is left frizzled. Someone calls out "Dee-Dee", and Dawn realizes that it is her childhood friend {{si|Kenny}}. Back at the [[Pokémon Center]], Kenny sits down with the group and sends out his {{TP|Kenny|Prinplup}}, the [[List of characters' first Pokémon|first Pokémon]] he obtained on his {{pkmn|journey}}. While Ash checks his [[Pokédex]], Piplup walks up to Prinplup, and Prinplup slaps it away. Kenny apologizes and explains that Prinplup does not like when others get too close. As Piplup and Prinplup attempt a stare-down rivalry, Kenny reveals he too is a [[Pokémon Coordinator]], and tells Dawn that he watched the {{ci|Jubilife}} Contest on [[television]]. Dawn is surprised to hear that Kenny has become a Coordinator, as she does not remember him being interested in Pokémon Contests when they were younger. Kenny tells Dawn that he made it to the final round of his very first Pokémon Contest, but lost to [[Zoey]] and her {{TP|Zoey|Glameow}}. Kenny asks Ash if he is competing in the Floaroma Contest, and he finds out about Ash's goal to conquer the [[Sinnoh League]]. Kenny suddenly switches topics about childhood stories, which irritates Dawn. He quickly brings up three stories that embarrass Dawn: her self-inflicted {{p|Chimchar}}-style haircut, her fumble during a childhood play, and wearing two different shoes and pajamas to school. Dawn loses it and challenges Kenny to a {{pkmn|battle}}, but he ignores her for a battle against Ash's Pikachu, mainly for experience. Kenny's Prinplup faces off against Pikachu. Pikachu attacks first with Thunderbolt, but Prinplup uses {{m|Metal Claw}} to block the attack, sending it back with appeal. Prinplup charges with {{m|Drill Peck}}, flying up and coming down. Pikachu uses the spin dodge method and lands an {{m|Iron Tail}}, sending its opponent hurtling towards the field. Prinplup, however, uses {{m|Bubble Beam}} to dampen the fall. While [[Jessie]] is getting ready for the Contest, [[James]] and {{MTR}} take note of Prinplup and decide to grab it. {{TP|Jessie|Seviper}} uses {{m|Haze}} to cover the field, disrupting the battle. Ash quickly sends out {{AP|Staravia}} to blow the haze away, just as {{TRT}} wraps Prinplup. Kenny tries to save Prinplup, but {{TP|James|Cacnea}} and {{TP|James|Carnivine}} knock them aside. Cacnea, Carnivine, and Seviper attack the group, but Piplup jumps up and uses a brand new [[move]], {{m|Whirlpool}}, to absorb the blitz attack. Piplup launches the attack towards Team Rocket, restoring Prinplup's energy and allowing it to free itself. Piplup and Prinplup set aside the rivalry and both send Team Rocket flying with Bubble Beam. The Floaroma Contest starts up the next day. Backstage, Kenny and Dawn are preparing. Dawn embarrasses Kenny due to the fact she is wearing a dress. Dawn goes first on the [[Appeal|Performance Stage]], and she sends out Pachirisu. Although it appears in a graceful manner, it trips on its tail and crashes into the [[Contest Judge]]s' desk. It begins to panic and run around frightened. Dawn suddenly gets an idea on how to fix the problem. ==Major events== * {{an|Dawn}} meets up with {{si|Kenny}}, her childhood friend and newest [[rival]]. * {{Ash}} and {{an|Brock}} meet Kenny for the first time. * Ash has a battle with Kenny, which gets interrupted by {{TRT}}. * [[Dawn's Piplup]] learns {{m|Whirlpool}}. * Dawn, Kenny, and [[Jessie|Jessilina]] enter the [[Floaroma Town]] [[Pokémon Contest]]. {{animeevents|DP}} ===Debuts=== ====Humans==== * {{si|Kenny}} ====Pokémon debuts==== * [[Kenny's Prinplup]] * {{p|Kricketune}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{Ash}} * {{an|Dawn}} * {{an|Brock}} * [[Jessie]] * [[James]] * [[Nurse Joy]] * [[Zoey]] (flashback) * {{si|Kenny}} * [[Marian]] * [[Raoul Contesta]] * [[Mr. Sukizo]] * {{pkmn|Coordinator}}s * Audience * Children (flashback) ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Pikachu}} ({{OP|Ash|Pikachu}}) * {{p|Meowth}} ({{TRM}}) * {{p|Piplup}} ({{OP|Dawn|Piplup}}) * {{p|Wobbuffet}} ({{OP|Jessie|Wobbuffet}}) * {{p|Mime Jr.}} ({{OP|James|Mime Jr.}}) * {{p|Staravia}} ({{OP|Ash|Staravia}}) * {{p|Buneary}} ({{OP|Dawn|Buneary}}) * {{p|Pachirisu}} ({{OP|Dawn|Pachirisu}}) * {{p|Seviper}} ({{OP|Jessie|Seviper}}) * {{p|Dustox}} ({{OP|Jessie|Dustox}}) * {{p|Cacnea}} ({{OP|James|Cacnea}}) * {{p|Carnivine}} ({{OP|James|Carnivine}}) * {{p|Glameow}} ({{OP|Zoey|Glameow}}; The same thing happened in an [[AG174|earlier episode]]. *** However, the motto theme is played in the scene where James and Meowth wrap up [[Kenny's Prinplup]]. ===Errors=== * In the English [[dub]], Dawn says that only one person knows about "Dee-Dee". However, this was contradicted in ''[[DP161|Yes in Dee Dee, It's Dawn!]]'', as it is shown that her whole class knows about "Dee-Dee". **This was further contradicted in ''[[DP063|Hot Springing a Leak!]]'', with [[Leona]] also referring to her as "Dee-Dee". * In one scene, [[Ash's Staravia]] uses {{m|Gust}}, a move [[Animated series move errors|it cannot learn legally in the games]]. ===Dub edits=== * In the English dub, Kenny thinks Dawn caught a Pikachu and she explains that it is Ash's and not hers. In the original Japanese version, Kenny's nickname for Dawn is "Pikari", so when he sees Dawn and Pikachu together, he assumes that Pikachu is hers and says that they are the "Pika-Pika" combo of Pikari and Pikachu. * In the English dub, Dawn doesn't watch Kenny's first Contest because she claims she was busy. In the original Japanese version, Dawn says that she didn't know about the Contest Kenny was in and that he was a Coordinator. * In the original Japanese version, Dawn tells Kenny that Ash is a great Trainer that she met and traveled with from the beginning, and that he won against [[Roark]]. In the English dub, she goes into more detail about how she met Ash.
